description:
Free, no key needed: the machine-readable price list — cost in units
    ($0.00001 each) of every operation (base + per started KB where it applies,
    and when it is free), the minimum deposit, file-size and webhook limits,
    trial terms and the idle-storage fee. Same document as GET /pricing. Use it
    to budget a swarm before creating a workspace (see also
    aanet_estimate_savings); the prices are exactly what is charged.
name: aanet_get_pricing
